scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Welcome to Christopher's Workshop. Ye can get all yer stuff for forging here. What business
brings ye to me?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
歡迎來克里斯托弗工坊，鍛造用的東西這裡應有盡有。
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: Purchase Anvil
scripts.translation: 購買鐵砧

scripts.text: Purchase Forging Item
scripts.translation: 購買鍛造工具

scripts.text: Purchase Metal
scripts.translation: 購買金屬

scripts.text: Purify Rough Ores
scripts.translation: 提純粗礦石

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
A better Anvil gives ye a greeeater chance to make better weapons, ye know? But they'll cost ye more zeny. Just get it off yer chest and buy what fits your purposes best, laddy.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你知道的，更好的鐵砧能大大增加鍛造出優質武器的機率，但價格也會更貴。
別客氣，挑個最適合你的吧，夥計。

scripts.text: Anvil - 30,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 鐵砧 - 30,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Oridecon Anvil - 120,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 神之金屬鐵砧 - 120,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Golden Anvil - 300,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 黃金鐵砧 - 300,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Better Anvil than the others.
scripts.translation: 還有更好的鐵砧嗎

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你這點Zeny可買不起，我總不能賠本賣吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
This is the cheapest one, but efficient enough to forge most items. Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop.  Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
這是最便宜的一款，但足以鍛造大多數物品。
感謝光臨我的工作室。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你這點Zeny可買不起，我總不能賠本賣吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Aye, friend ye have an eye for the anvil. This must be the proper anvil for a Blacksmith, eh? Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop.  Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
哎呀，朋友，你很有眼光嘛。這絕對是鐵匠該用的鐵砧，對吧？
感謝光臨我的工作室。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你這點Zeny可買不起，我總不能賠本賣吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
This one is the best among all me stuffs in me workshop! With this, ye can rule the Blacksmith world! Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop.  Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
這是我工作室裡所有物品中最好的！有了它，你就能稱霸鐵匠界了！
感謝光臨我的工作室。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Well, sorry. But I don't have anythin' harder' than the Golden Anvil.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
嗯，抱歉。但我這裡沒有比黃金鐵砧更硬的鐵砧了。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Me thinks 'Ringgel,' the Legendary Anvil Maker would have one. But, I don't think ye can find him, though he be somewhere in this world.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
傳說中的鐵砧大師“林格爾”那裡也許有。
不過，雖然他就在這世上的某個地方，你恐怕很難找到。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Okay, feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
好的，隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。再見。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
A respectable blacksmith uses fine tools. Ye can become one o'those with me Stuff. Choose anything ye want.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
好鐵匠得用好工具，用我的工具，你也能成為受人敬重的鐵匠。
看中什麼就挑吧。

scripts.text: Mini-Furnace - 150 zeny
scripts.translation: 迷你熔爐 - 150 Zeny

scripts.text: Iron Hammer - 1000 zeny
scripts.translation: 鋼鐵錘子 - 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: Golden Hammer - 3000 zeny
scripts.translation: 黃金錘子 - 3000 Zeny

scripts.text: Oridecon Hammer - 5000 zeny
scripts.translation: 神之金屬錘子 - 5000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
It's a much needed tool fer refining metal! So, How many do ye wish to buy? If ye want to quit, just type the number '0.'
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
提煉金屬可少不了它！
要買幾個？想取消就輸入0。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Aye, the deal is canceled. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
好的，交易已取消。再見。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye can buy 500, er less.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
最多買500個。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你這點Zeny可買不起，我總不能賠本賣吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye look like you don't got enough room in yer inventory. Put some stuff into your Kafra Storage, why don't ye?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
背包空間好像不夠了，先把一些東西存進卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop. Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
感謝你在我的工坊購物。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]

感謝你在我的工坊購物。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。再見。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I prepare every Metal, and only the high quality ones o'course. Now then, which one do ye need?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
我備有各種金屬，當然都是高品質的。那麼，你需要哪一種？

Ye can buy 500, er less.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
最多買500個。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye don't have enough money. Ye know I can't sell this at a lower price... You know how the wifey nags about Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你的錢不夠，可別指望我降價...
我老婆成天為Zeny唸叨個不停。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye look like you don't have the room to carry anythin' new. Why don't ye put some things into Kafra Storage n' come back.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
你背包裝不下新東西了，先把一些存進卡普拉倉庫，再來吧。

scripts.text:

Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop. Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
感謝你在我的工坊購物。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Me friend... Seems to me ye don't have Inventory space. Why doncha put some things into Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
朋友...背包空間不夠了，先存點東西進卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop. Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need, whenever ye want.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
感謝你在我的工坊購物。隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我，想什麼時候來就什麼時候來。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。再見。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I can purify yer Oridecon and Elunium. I make a refined Ore out of 5 o'each rough ones. Well... Which one do ye want to make?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
我能幫你提煉神之金屬和鋁，每5個同類原石煉成1個成品。
想煉哪種？

scripts.text: Make Oridecon
scripts.translation: 製作神之金屬

scripts.text: Make Elunium
scripts.translation: 製作鋁

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I told ye, I need 5 o'the rough Oridecons fer one Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
我說過，我需要5個神之金屬原石才能製成1個神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Here's an Oridecon fer ye. Ye will be always welcome here, I'll be waitin' for ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
這是你的神之金屬。這裡永遠歡迎你的到來，我會一直在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I told ye, I need 5 rough Eluniums fer one Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
我說過，我需要5個鋁原石才能製成1個鋁。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Arrr, here's yer Elunium. Yer business is always welcome here, so feel free to come again.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
啊，這是你的鋁。這裡永遠歡迎你的光顧，請隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
隨時歡迎再來，有需要儘管找我。再見。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need and whenever ye want. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉倫羅]
有需要，或是想來了，隨時來找我。
再見。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

- 你攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Welcome, my friend.
In my shop, you will find everything that you need in forging.
Tell me what you need.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
歡迎，我的朋友。
在我的店裡，你能找到鍛造所需的一切。
請告訴我你需要什麼。

scripts.text: Purchase Anvil.
scripts.translation: 購買鐵砧

scripts.text: Purchase Forging Items.
scripts.translation: 購買鍛造材料

scripts.text: Purchase Metal.
scripts.translation: 購買金屬

scripts.text: Process Ores.
scripts.translation: 提純礦石

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Anvil is the most necessary item for Blacksmiths.
Since you will use an Anvil more than once, you'd better buy a nice one.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
鐵砧是鐵匠不可或缺的工具。
要長期使用，最好買個好一些的。

scripts.text: Anvil - 30,000z.
Oridecon Anvil - 120,000z.
scripts.translation: 神之金屬鐵砧 - 120,000z

scripts.text: Golden Anvil - 300,000z.
I need a better anvil.
scripts.translation: 我需要更好的鐵砧

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
With that much of money, you cannot even buy a toy anvil!
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
就這點錢，連玩具鐵砧都買不起！

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
It is the cheapest anvil which has the most basic ability.
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
這是最便宜的鐵砧，具備最基本的功能。
感謝光顧我的店鋪。如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
With that much of money, you cannot even buy a toy anvil!
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
就這點錢，連玩具鐵砧都買不起！

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Ah, you have an eye for anvil. A Blacksmith needs an anvil at least as good as this.
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
啊，你很有眼光。鐵匠至少需要這樣質量的鐵砧。
感謝光顧我的店鋪。如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
With that much of money, you cannot even buy a toy anvil!
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
就這點錢，連玩具鐵砧都買不起！

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can tell your ambition to become a good Blacksmith just by looking at you to choose this Golden Anvil!
This anvil will surely aid you in creating the best weapons.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
看你選黃金鐵砧，就知道你有志成為優秀的鐵匠！
它一定能幫你打造出最出色的武器。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I am sorry, but I do not sell better anvils than Golden Anvil.
Unless you find the legendary anvil of 'Linggell', I don't think that you could find better one than Golden Anvil in any other places.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
很抱歉，我這裡沒有比黃金鐵砧更好的鐵砧了。
除非你能找到傳說中的“林格爾”鐵砧，否則我想你在別處也找不到比黃金鐵砧更好的了。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You need various materials to process ores and to forge weapons.
I have everything that you need. Take a look.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
你需要各種材料來加工礦石和鍛造武器。
我這裡應有盡有。請看看。

scripts.text: Mini Furnace - 150z.
scripts.translation: 攜帶用熔礦爐 - 150z

scripts.text: Iron Hammer - 1,000z.
scripts.translation: 鋼鐵錘子 - 1,000z

scripts.text: Golden Hammer - 3,000z.

You definitely need this furnace to process ores!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

要買多少？取消交易就輸入0。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You have canceled the trade. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
你已取消交易。如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You can only buy 500 or less at a time.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
一次最多買500個。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You don't have enough money. Sorry, I cannot sell them at a loss.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
你的Zeny不足。抱歉，我不能虧本賣給你。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Hey, you look pale. Why don't you go lighten your weight first.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
嘿，你臉色不太好，先去減輕點負重吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
感謝光顧我的店鋪。如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I have high quality metal.
So, which metal would you like to buy?
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
我有高質量的金屬。
那麼，你想買哪種金屬？

scripts.text: Phracon - 200z.
scripts.translation: 強化武器金屬-級數一 - 200 Zeny

scripts.text: Emveretarcon - 1,000z.
scripts.translation: 強化武器金屬-級數二 - 1,000z

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
So, how many of them do you need? If you want to cancel the trade, enter '0'.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
要買多少？取消交易就輸入0。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
The trade has been canceled. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
交易已取消。如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You can buy 500 or less at a time.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
一次最多買500個。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You don't have enough money. Sorry, I cannot sell them at a loss.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
你的Zeny不足。抱歉，我不能虧本賣給你。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Hey, you look pale. Why don't you go lighten your weight first?
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
嘿，你臉色不太好，先去減輕點負重吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
感謝光顧我的店鋪。如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

You need 5 ores to process them into one pure Oridecon.

我能幫你提煉神之金屬和鋁，每5個同類原石煉成1個成品。
想煉哪種？
[保羅·斯潘納]
5個神之金屬原石才能煉成1個純淨的神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.
So, which one do you want to process?
[Paul Spanner]
There you go. Thank you for using my service.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
我能幫你提煉神之金屬和鋁，每5個同類原石煉成1個成品。
想煉哪種？
[保羅·斯潘納]
給你，感謝使用我的服務。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.

[Paul Spanner]
You need 5 ores to process them into one pure Elunium.
scripts.translation:

我能幫你提煉神之金屬和鋁，每5個同類原石煉成1個成品。
想煉哪種？
[保羅·斯潘納]
5個鋁原石才能煉成1個純淨的鋁。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.
So, which one do you want to process?
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
我能幫你提煉神之金屬和鋁，每5個同類原石煉成1個成品。
想煉哪種？
[保羅·斯潘納]
有需要，儘管告訴我。

scripts.text: Oridecon

scripts.text: Elunium

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保羅·斯潘納]
如果你需要任何幫助，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn]
I'm a blacksmith who can refine weapons and equipment.
Do you have any items that you'd like to refine?
scripts.translation:
[霍爾格雷恩]
我是一名可以精煉武器和裝備的鐵匠。
你有想要精煉的物品嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aragham]
De~ sert~ Blacksmith~
Aragham Ssaleh~ who can refine anything Ssaleh~
Let me see what you'd like to refine~
scripts.translation:
[阿拉甘]
沙~漠~鐵匠~
阿拉甘 Ssaleh~什麼都能精煉 Ssaleh~
讓我看看，你想精煉什麼~

scripts.text:
[Antonio]
Stop nagging and get me the equipment you want to refine.
scripts.translation:
[安東尼奧]
別嘮叨了，把你想要精煉的裝備拿來。

scripts.text:
[Fredrik Hermanthorn]
I am a blacksmith who can refine your weapon or equipment.
Do you have anything that you'd like to refine?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德里克·赫曼索恩]
我是一名可以精煉你武器或裝備的鐵匠。
你有想要精煉的物品嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lambert]
Wel...come... This is... the best... smithy... in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[蘭伯特]
歡...迎...光臨...這裡是...朱諾...最好的...鐵匠鋪...

scripts.text:
[Manthasman Pruhag]
Hahaha, you already knew it. So you'd like to refine something?
Let's try something risky today!
scripts.translation:
[曼塔斯曼·普魯哈格]
Hahaha，你早就知道了吧，想精煉點什麼？
今天來冒個險吧！

scripts.text:
[Fulerr]
Hehe... You wanna refine?
Hehe.. Consider it done..
Hehe....
scripts.translation:
[富勒爾]
Hehe...想精煉？
Hehe..包在我身上..
Hehe....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the Armsmith.
I can refine all kinds of weapons, armor and equipment, so let me
know what you want me to refine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是武器匠。
我可以精煉各種武器、防具和裝備，請告訴我你想讓我精煉什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得你身上沒有我可以精煉的物品...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're not wearing
anything there that
I can refine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你沒穿戴可以精煉的裝備。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can
refine this item at all...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這件物品恐怕沒法精煉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this
any more. This is as
refined as it gets!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
已經不能再精煉了，這是最高精煉等級！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To refine this I need
one ^003366{1}^000000 and
a service fee of {2} Zeny.
Do you really wish to continue?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
精煉需要1個^003366{1}^000000，以及{2} Zeny服務費。
確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah...
There's no need to
rush. Take your time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...不用急，慢慢考慮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no! If I continue to
refine this, there's a risk it could
be destroyed! That means that ^FF0000this equipment^000000, and ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to this armor, ^FF0000will be gone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再繼續精煉，就有損毀的風險！
也就是說，^FF0000這件裝備^000000、鑲嵌的^FF0000所有卡片^000000以及附加在防具上的特殊屬性，^FF0000都會消失^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no! If I continue to
refine this, there's a risk it could
be destroyed, and you'd ^FF0000lose the weapon^000000, any ^FF0000cards in the weapon^000000,
or any added special properties.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再繼續精煉，就有損毀的風險！
屆時你會^FF0000失去武器^000000、^FF0000鑲嵌在武器裡的所有卡片^000000，以及附加的特殊屬性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't make it any clearer.
Once a weapon is destroyed,
there's no getting it back.
You really have a chance to
^FF0000lose this weapon^000000 forever.
Do you still want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經說得很清楚了，武器一旦損毀，就再也找不回來。
你可能^FF0000永遠失去這把武器^000000。
還要繼續精煉嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I completely agree...
I might be a great refiner, but sometimes even I make mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全同意...
雖然我可能是個很棒的精煉師，但有時候連我也會犯錯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You don't seem to have
enough Zeny or {1}...
Go get some more. I'll be
here all day if you need me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的Zeny或{1}不夠...
再去準備些吧，我整天都在這兒。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下...
你覺得我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意你換了物品！給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OH! MY GOD!
Damn it! Not again!
I'm terribly sorry, but you know practice does make perfect.
Um, right? Heh heh...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！該死，又失敗了！
真對不起，不過熟能生巧嘛。
嗯，對吧？Heh heh...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nooooooo!
It broke!
I-I'm sorry!

[{0}]
Crap!
It couldn't take
much more tempering!
Sorry about this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟了！
它承受不住更多的淬鍊了！
對此我很抱歉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Perfect!
Heh heh!
Once again,
flawless work
from the master~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完美！Heh heh!
大師又完成了一件無可挑剔的傑作~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Success...!
Yet again, my amazing
talent truly dazzles
and shines today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
成功...！
今天，我驚人的才華再次大放異彩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Heh heh!
I'm all done.
No doubt, my work is
to your satisfaction.
Sheer, utter perfection~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Heh heh!完成了。
你一定滿意，簡直完美無缺~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can refine this to the safe limit or a desired number of times. It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以精煉到安全上限或指定的次數。由你選擇。

scripts.text: To the safe limit, please.
scripts.translation: 請精煉到安全上限

scripts.text: I'll decide how many times.
scripts.translation: 我來決定次數

scripts.text: I've changed my mind...
scripts.translation: 我改變主意了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How many times would you like me to refine your item?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想讓我精煉你的物品多少次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this item that many times.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我無法精煉這個物品那麼多次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This will try to refine the equipment {1} times past the safe limit. Your equipment may be destroyed... is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這將嘗試在安全上限之外再精煉{1}次。你的裝備可能會被破壞...這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: Yes...
scripts.translation: 是的...

scripts.text: No...

[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你這麼說...那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你這麼說...那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That will cost you {1} {2} and {3} Zeny. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
需要{1}個{2}和{3} Zeny，可以嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No...

[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你這麼說...那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that all you got? Unfortunately I can't work for you at a lower price. Try putting yourself in my shoes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就這些？抱歉，我不能少收錢。
也替我想想吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look here... you don't have any items on...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂...你根本沒穿戴裝備...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang... No, but did you imagine I could be so stupid?!
You changed it...
Get out before I stun you with my Hammer!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Clang...你以為我有那麼蠢嗎？！
你把裝備換了...
趁我還沒拿錘子敲暈你，趕緊滾！！

scripts.text:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!! I'm so sorry... I warned you this could happen...
scripts.translation:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!!真對不起...我提醒過你，可能會發生這種事...

scripts.text:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!! I'm so sorry... I warned you this could happen...
Here's the unused Zeny and materials back...
scripts.translation:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!!真對不起...我提醒過你，可能會發生這種事...
沒用完的Zeny和材料，還給你...

scripts.text: Clang, clang!!!
scripts.translation: Clang, clang!!!

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All finished... Come again soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
全部完成了...歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I sell 2 kinds of Metal
for tempering weaponry.
I have ^007777Phracon^000000 for Level 1
Weapons, and ^007777Emveretarcon^000000
for Level 2 Weapons.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我出售兩種用於強化武器的金屬。
我有^007777強化武器金屬-級數一^000000，用於1級武器，
以及^007777強化武器金屬-級數二^000000，用於2級武器。

scripts.text: Phracon - 200 Zeny
scripts.translation: 強化武器金屬-級數一 - 200 Zeny

scripts.text: Emveretarcon - 1000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 強化武器金屬-級數二 - 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: Ask about other Metals
scripts.translation: 詢問其他金屬

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Other metals?
Well, you'll need special metals to upgrade higher level weapons, or any kind of armor. But you know, Oridecon and Elunium is really
hard to just find...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其他金屬？
精煉高階武器或防具，需要特殊金屬，不過神之金屬和鋁可不好找...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So how many do you wish to buy?
If you don't want any, please enter the number, '0.'
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼你想買多少呢？
如果你不想買，請輸入數字“0”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The deal has
been cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
交易已取消。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, you can
puchase up to 500.
No more than that,
got it? Good.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，你最多可以購買500個。
不能超過這個數量，明白了嗎？很好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err...
You don't have
enough Zeny to buy
{1} of them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
你的Zeny不夠購買{1}個。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
I can't give you anything if you don't have enough room in your inventory. Why don't you put your extra things in Kafra Storage and try again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
背包空間不夠，我可沒法把東西給你。
先把多餘物品存進卡普拉倉庫，再來試試。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are!
Thank you for
your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給你！
感謝惠顧。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can purify your
Rough Oridecons or
Rough Eluniums. I'll need
5 Rough Stones to make
1 pure one for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以提純你的神之金屬原石或鋁原石。
我需要5塊原石才能為你製作1塊純金屬。

scripts.text: Make Oridecon
scripts.translation: 製作神之金屬

scripts.text: Make Elunium
scripts.translation: 製作鋁

scripts.text: Ask about Enchanted Stones
scripts.translation: 詢問屬性原石

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's your Oridecon.
You're welcome to come
back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的神之金屬。
歡迎隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're kidding me, right?
I just told you that I need 5 Rough Oridecons to make a pure Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在開玩笑吧？
我剛才才告訴你，我需要5塊神之金屬原石才能製作1塊純神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's your Elunium.
You're welcome to come
back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的鋁。
歡迎隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're kidding me, right?
I just told you that I need 5 Rough Eluniums to make a pure Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在開玩笑吧？
我剛才才告訴你，我需要5塊鋁原石才能製作1塊純鋁。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Enchanted Stones...?
I've been a stonesmith for 20 years, so I've heard a lot about them. Supposedly, there are
four different kinds.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
屬性原石...？
我做石匠20年了，聽過不少關於它們的事，據說一共有四種。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Each Enchanted Stone possesses one of the following elemental properties: Earth, Wind, Water and Fire.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
每種屬性原石都擁有地、風、水、火四種屬性之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If someone combines a Enchanted Stone with a weapon while smithing, that weapon will possess the same property as the Stone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鍛造武器時加入屬性原石，就能讓武器獲得相同的屬性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Needless to say, you need to have some smithing skill to produce this kind of elemental weapon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用說，你需要具備一定的鍛造技能才能製作這種屬性武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey there!
Do you want me
to repair any items?
You can count on me
for item repairs!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你好！
你想讓我修復什麼物品嗎？
物品修復就交給我吧！

scripts.text: Actually, I do have some items...
scripts.translation: 我確實有一些物品...

scripts.text: None at the moment.
scripts.translation: 暫時沒有

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh wow, this is incredible!
You must take very good care of your things. None of your items are damaged!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇哦，這太不可思議了！
你一定非常愛惜你的東西。你的物品都沒有損壞！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If everyone is like you, I'm going to be unemployed!! Haha~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人人都像你這樣愛惜裝備，我可就要失業了！！Haha~!

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
Let's see...
Out of all your items,
{1} are damaged.
Would you like to repair?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...讓我看看...
你有{1}件物品損壞了，要修理嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Each repair costs {1} Zeny. So to repair all your damaged items would cost {2} Zeny! Would you like to repair the items?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
每件修理費{1} Zeny，全部修好需要{2} Zeny！
要修理嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa whoa...
Check your wallet before you receive the repair bill! I can't repair anything because you don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哎...先看看錢包吧，你的Zeny不夠，我沒法修理。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay! All done. Now, try to be a little more careful. Items have lives too you know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，全修好了。
以後小心點，物品也是有生命的嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mmm? Something's wrong. Wait... Equip the items you need to repair and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？有點不對勁。等等...請裝備你需要修復的物品，然後再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's no skin off my nose, but it's not good to leave items damaged. You should get them repaired as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，雖然對我來說沒什麼大不了的，但讓物品保持損壞狀態是不好的。你應該儘快去修復它們！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hohoho...
You don't have
any business with me
if you don't have any
items to repair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Hohoho...
沒東西要修，我們也就沒什麼生意好談了。
